steps.description: Navigate to /
Start the quiz from the dashboard

title: Review the dashboard overview from top to bottom
description: This verifies that a user can open the main dashboard and review the AI insight widgets and usage statistics by scrolling through the page.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify the main dashboard content is visible
Scroll through the dashboard
Verify AI insight widgets and usage statistics are displayed

title: View the dashboard usage statistics section

Scroll through the dashboard
Verify usage statistics are displayed
Verify API usage and query count information is visible

title: See the completion confetti after submitting the quiz
description: This verifies that submitting a completed quiz triggers the animated success experience alongside the results state.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Start the quiz from the dashboard
Answer all quiz questions
Submit the quiz
Verify the completion celebration is visible
Verify the quiz results remain visible

title: Block partial quiz submission
description: This verifies that the quiz modal prevents submission when only some questions are answered and keeps the user in the quiz flow.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Start the quiz from the dashboard
Answer some quiz questions
Submit the quiz
Verify a validation error is visible
Verify the quiz remains open

title: Block empty quiz submission
description: This verifies that the quiz modal prevents submission when no answers are selected and shows required-answer validation.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Start the quiz from the dashboard
Submit the quiz without answering any questions
Verify a validation error is visible
Verify the quiz remains open

title: Reopen the quiz after closing it
description: This verifies that a user can exit the quiz modal and open it again without losing the ability to continue the flow from the dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Start the quiz from the dashboard
Close the quiz modal
Start the quiz from the dashboard again
Verify the quiz modal is displayed again
Verify the dashboard remains accessible behind the modal
